name: Stand-alone known-command help without client configuration
summary: client.main answers -h/--help for a known command before requiring or reading --config and --project. contributor_command_help keeps the usage text inside client.py, reuses the files and wait parsers, and performs no config reads, server contact or filesystem writes. Real-call refusals stay on their existing paths; an unknown command is not treated as known-command help. The copied-client tests cover files, checkpoint, brief, history, wait, review and docs with both help spellings in empty HOME, TMPDIR and working directories.
